program_solutions:
(rule!
 ;; Yellow(4) skeletons repeat around the board; the richest one (most
 ;; decoration colors) is the BASE. For each plain copy, find the
 ;; dihedral orientation mapping the base skeleton onto it — a red(2)
 ;; cell breaks symmetric ties — and stamp the base's decorations
 ;; through that orientation.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (val p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
     (define comps
       (filter (lambda (o) (any? (lambda (p) (= (val p) 4))
                                 (obj-cells o)))
               (objects-multicolor g 0)))
     (define (deco-colors o)
       (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 4)))
                                  (map val (obj-cells o)))))
     (define base (pick-max comps (lambda (o) (length (deco-colors o)))))
     (define (spin p idx)  ;; the 8 dihedral images of a cell
       (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
         (cond ((zero? idx) (list r c))
               ((= idx 1) (list c (- r)))
               ((= idx 2) (list (- r) (- c)))
               ((= idx 3) (list (- c) r))
               ((= idx 4) (list r (- c)))
               ((= idx 5) (list (- c) (- r)))
               ((= idx 6) (list (- r) c))
               (else (list c r)))))
     (define (sort-pos cells) (sort cells cell<))
     (define (yellows o) (filter (lambda (p) (= (val p) 4))
                                 (obj-cells o)))
     (define (rel cells r0 c0)
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0)))
            cells))
     (define base-y (yellows base))
     (define by-r0 (min-of first base-y))
     (define by-c0 (min-of second base-y))
     (define base-yrel (sort-pos (rel base-y by-r0 by-c0)))
     (define base-deco  ;; (dr dc color) for the base's decorations
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) by-r0)
                              (- (second p) by-c0)
                              (val p)))
            (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (val p) 4))) (obj-cells base))))
     (define base-twos
       (map (lambda (e) (list (first e) (second e)))
            (filter (lambda (e) (= (third e) 2)) base-deco)))
     (define (rel-after idx p)  ;; spin, then re-anchor on the skeleton
       (let* ((raws (map (lambda (q) (spin q idx)) base-yrel))
              (raw (spin p idx)))
         (list (- (first raw) (min-of first raws))
               (- (second raw) (min-of second raws)))))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((obj (in-list comps)))
       (if (> (length (deco-colors obj)) 1)
           out
           (let* ((ys (yellows obj))
                  (tr0 (min-of first ys))
                  (tc0 (min-of second ys))
                  (target-yrel (sort-pos (rel ys tr0 tc0)))
                  (target-twos
                   (sort-pos (rel (filter (lambda (p) (= (val p) 2))
                                          (obj-cells obj))
                                  tr0 tc0)))
                  (idx (find-first
                        (lambda (idx)
                          (and (equal? (sort-pos
                                        (map (lambda (p)
                                               (rel-after idx p))
                                             base-yrel))
                                       target-yrel)
                               (or (empty? target-twos)
                                   (any? (lambda (bp)
                                           (member (rel-after idx bp)
                                                   target-twos))
                                         base-twos))))
                        (range 0 8))))
             (if idx
                 (for/fold ((gg out)) ((e (in-list base-deco)))
                   (let ((p (rel-after idx (list (first e)
                                                 (second e)))))
                     (if (in-bounds? (+ tr0 (first p))
                                     (+ tc0 (second p)) h w)
                         (set-cell gg (+ tr0 (first p))
                                   (+ tc0 (second p)) (third e))
                         gg)))
                 out)))))))
